findings_so_far: The builders own report shows exterior_restored_on_exit = 115 in BOTH arms of its control. That third of headline claim 1 is vacuous: it passes on the round-1 build.

The 115 interior records admit at most 94 distinct build-relevant contents (largest identical group 7). The round-1 acceptance bar of >=100 distinct images is unreachable by construction on the shipped data.
21 of 115 records are content-duplicates of another record, including archon-apothecary == archon-vat-house and a helstrom apothecary/market/scriptorium/smithy that are one room.
The builder status file says 16 outdoors at 03:00; the blog line for the same round says 23. Two accounts of one number.

The snapshot already contains another agent ROUND 3 exterior work in game/src/world/province.js (+177 lines, uncommitted, importing render/exterior.js). The round-1 exterior blocker is being closed as I write and I do not grade it here.
113 of 115 interiors declare exactly 18 props and the 115 rooms have only 8 distinct floor areas. The rooms are built from their records and the records are a generator constant.
RI-WLD03 M14: every town declares 8-10 bespoke kit meshes and exactly 4 of each town has a builder in render/interior.js KIT. 32 of 69 built, all indoors.
LightField.addSource() has one caller in game/src and it is the harness verb. 827 declared interior lights are drawn and unread by the model that decides whether you can be seen.
